name: hornhoof
description: Your own company of AI agents: any models, your own computers.
author: Ivan Korol

scripts.lint: npm run build -w @hornhoof/protocol && npm run lint:part --workspaces --include-workspace-root --
scripts.check:author: node scripts/author-check.mjs
scripts.typecheck:tests: npm run build -w @hornhoof/protocol && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.eslint.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/node/tsconfig.eslint.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/protocol/tsconfig.eslint.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: node scripts/check-release.mjs --local && npm run typecheck:tests && npm run -s build -w @hornhoof/node && npm run test:release && vitest run
scripts.test:real: npm run build -w @hornhoof/protocol && npm run test:real -w @hornhoof/server
scripts.test:lab: npm run build -w @hornhoof/protocol && npm run test:lab -w @hornhoof/server
